concerns.confirmed_behavior: Sample size and quality enter influence_weight (sqrt(n/600) and quality_weight) in poll_weights.attach_poll_weights, and again inflate observation precision via poll_se = 100/sqrt(n)/sqrt(qw)/sqrt(iw) in pymc_model._prepare and obs_var = (100/sqrt(n))^2 / (qw*iw) in state_space.fit_state_space.
Recency uses absolute calendar age exp(-ln2 * age / half_life). After caps, per-race influence weights are renormalized to mean ≈ 1.
fit_state_space adds a fixed process variance increment (+0.8**2) once per poll observation, independent of elapsed calendar days between polls.
